newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Desertstone shares dive after report.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Desertstone shares dive after report.

text.p: Shares in Gawler Craton gold hopeful Desertstone NL slipped sharply in early trade on Thursday, losing 48 percent to an intraday low of A$0.33 after a progress report on its Lake Torrens project failed to live up to early expectations.

The report cited difficult drilling conditions and initial assay results that showed only sub-economic gold values, with previously advised tentatively identified gold mineralisation failing to be confirmed.
"It wasn't a negative report really but it wasn't up to expectations," said a Perth-based dealer.
"There were a lot of eager people waiting on some very good results but they haven't eventuated yet, and the traders who were in there for a quick turn are obviously getting out while they can."
Desertstone shares shares started to run on January 23, jumping 110 percent to 60 cents after the company lodged an announcemnt on drilling programme progress to the Australian Stock Exchange.
By 11.30 a.m. (0030 GMT), Desertstone shares were down 27 cents on the day at 37 cents on turnover of 2.2 million shares.
